observations.methodology: Five fresh processes per version and input, alternating order, workUnits=1. No fonts. Process-local caches empty; OS page cache uncontrolled. Probe timer covers each C++ step only, excluding begin/input-copy/output-take, validation and IPC. Host duration includes all those and process startup. Other goal test processes finished before this diagnostic; general system load uncontrolled. Not p95, a production workload, cancellation acknowledgement, physical memory reclamation or replacement acceptance.
